stem:
Meena spills some water on the cement floor of her courtyard on a hot, windy afternoon. After some time, the water is no longer visible.

What most likely happened to the water?

options.text: It only seeped into the cement floor.
It only changed into water vapour by evaporation.
It partly seeped into the cement floor and partly evaporated into water vapour.
It disappeared without seeping or evaporating.

teacher.key_rationale: Cement is porous, so some water seeps in, and the hot, windy conditions also drive evaporation; both processes can occur together, so C is correct. A and B each omit one process; D is impossible since water cannot simply vanish.
